description_en: Invokes ListCloudAccountResources to perform a paged query of cloud account resources through paging
description_zh: 调用ListCloudAccountResources分页查询云账号资源列表
name: ListCloudAccountResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IDaaS EIAM instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page during paging in a paged query. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。默认值为20，最大值为100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud account
parameters.name: cloud_account_id

parameters.help_en: Filters resources by entity type. Valid values: ram_policy
parameters.help_zh: 按实体类型过滤，枚举值：ram_policy
parameters.name: cloud_account_resource_entity_type

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the resource name used for matching
parameters.name: cloud_account_resource_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: The keyword used for fuzzy matching of the resource name. This is equivalent to LIKE '%value%'
parameters.help_zh: 按资源名称模糊匹配，等价于 LIKE '%value%'
parameters.name: cloud_account_resource_name_contains

CloudAccountResources.description_en: The list of cloud account resources

CloudAccountId.description_en: The ID of the cloud account to which the resource belongs

CloudAccountResourceEntityId.description_en: The unique remote identifier of the resource entity
CloudAccountResourceEntityId.description_zh: 资源实体标识，远端唯一标识

CloudAccountResourceEntityType.description_en: The type of the resource entity. Valid values: ram_role

CloudAccountResourceId.description_en: The identifier of the cloud account resource

CamPolicyDocument.description_en: The JSON string of the Tencent Cloud CAM policy document. This parameter is returned only for Tencent Cloud accounts
CamPolicyDocument.description_zh: 腾讯云 CAM 策略文档 JSON。仅腾讯云云账号返回

CamPolicyType.description_en: The type of the Tencent Cloud CAM policy. Valid values: qcs and local. This parameter is returned only for Tencent Cloud accounts
CamPolicyType.description_zh: 腾讯云 CAM 策略类型，枚举值：qcs、local。仅腾讯云云账号返回

IamPolicyDocument.description_en: The JSON string of the AWS IAM policy document. This parameter is returned only for AWS cloud accounts
IamPolicyDocument.description_zh: AWS IAM 策略文档 JSON。仅 AWS 云账号返回

IamPolicyType.description_en: The type of the AWS IAM policy. Valid values: aws and local. This parameter is returned only for AWS cloud accounts
IamPolicyType.description_zh: AWS IAM 策略类型，枚举值：aws、local。仅 AWS 云账号返回

RamPolicyDocument.description_en: The JSON string of the RAM policy document. This parameter is returned only by the Get operation
RamPolicyDocument.description_zh: RAM 策略文档 JSON，仅 Get 接口返回

RamPolicyType.description_en: The type of the RAM policy. Valid values: system and custom

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

Description.example: 用于SSO单点登录的云账号资源

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the resource was last updated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 最近一次更新时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page during paging in a paged query

NextToken.description_en: The query token returned by the current call for the next pagination query
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）值，用于下一次翻页查询
NextToken.title_en: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）值。
NextToken.title_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）值。

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
